name: Duruku Saadomadi
original_name: ドゥルク・サードマディ
source: The leader of the Defiant Dragons, a revolutionary group that seeks to overthrow the current regime in Khura'in. [spoiler]He is a royal consort of the former Queen Amara. He is also the biological father of Nahyuta and Rayfa, and a foster father of Apollo.[/spoiler]
